headline: Budget transfers and added funding, including $500,000 for the Chippanee golf course and $14,744,773 for special education.
summary: Most budget items for city departments are on the consent agenda. Other items include a bid waiver to Firematic, a Board of Education budget update, and a Banking & Audit subcommittee report.
items: Aging: $17,478 added to Senior Center Activity Fund
PRYCS: $10,000 added and $6,906 transferred within Special Grants and Donations Fund
BECC: $9,000 in transfers within Special Grants and Donations Fund
BOE: $8,856 added to Special Grants and Donations Fund
BOE: $14,744,773 added to Special Education Grant Fund
Public Works: $43,500 in transfers within Equipment Building Sinking Fund
Public Works: $37,000 added to Transfer Station Fund
Police: $50,000 transfer from General Fund Contingency account
Fire: $50,000 transfer from General Fund Contingency account
PRYCS: $500,000 added to Chippanee Municipal Golf Course Fund
Comptroller authorized to countersign contracts as to availability of funding
location: City Hall Council Chambers, 111 North Main Street, Bristol, Connecticut
